new_summary: The Transformer was introduced in the 2017 paper “Attention Is All You Need.” Unlike recurrent models such as RNNs and LSTMs, it processes token sequences in parallel rather than step by step. Self-attention lets every token relate directly to relevant tokens elsewhere in the sequence, while multi-head attention captures different relationship types. These properties make Transformers highly parallelizable, scalable to large datasets, and effective for long-range dependencies. This architecture became the foundation for BERT, GPT, and modern large language models.
